# cents from origin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:centsFromOrigin`](gmeow-centsFromOrigin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/centsFromOrigin>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A convenience measure of a pitch or interval in cents, generated from the exact ratio by fnRatioToCents. Not canonical; the ratio pair is canonical ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).
